prompts.task: Copy genai-default-audit.json into matching canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it and request OTEL-001 using the bundled selection flow. Its operation plan and acceptance tests must require no tool/workflow operation nodes unless later source actually adds such operations; do not ask for one of each model/tool node or use a generic source-only guardrail to excuse contradictory per-case counts. Record that topology and distinguish proposed SDK span-kind mapping from source/runtime proof; a future remote CLIENT interpretation must be conditional on an actual remote provider boundary and kept separate from the captured synthetic fixture's known separate-process model. Include repeated runs, mixed existing/missing resources, duplicate-conflict exact relookup, ID lookup-only and failed-lookup isolation; the OTEL-001-only case authorizes no project/Agent Stream provisioning or AO configuration side effects. Assess the isolated installed public start_splunk_ao_span/schema-helper evidence separately from logger-only enrichment limitations. Use supported helper capabilities at real source operations where evidenced, with same-span bounded safe mappings and parent context, while recording exact remaining operation-specific gaps such as the separate-process model requiring CLIENT when the probed helper emits INTERNAL. Do not turn either a logger-only limitation into a blanket SDK blocker or an in-memory helper probe into production exporter/app/cloud proof. This remains a plan-only task: preserve every input and source/profile/dependency/test file, and make no implementation or live creation claims. Separately assess the usage_registry_reconciliation cases in genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json, using its independently captured full official registry receipt with exact path/revision/date/hash, not inferred absence from selected docs rows. Give a concrete useful mapping for the fresh case reported input17/output5 and source-derived total22 with count provenance, and assess the candidate proposal; separately preserve the exact existing legacy alias used by the supplied legacy consumer. Apply official versus application/vendor versus proven legacy distinctions to actual app.py estimates and other source cases as applicable, without inventing absent fields or silently removing old consumer contracts. Separately reconcile operation_metadata_reconciliation in genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json. Plan exact source-backed owning-agent/tool context fields for its fixed-model, dynamic-model and unbound source cases: configured agent description, applicable fixed agent request model, tool-owning agent, approved opaque conversation and actual tool definition description/type. Keep current official conditional/recommended levels and model applicability footnote separate from required known-field acceptance, never borrow context between cases or derive a description by paraphrasing a prompt. Assess known successful response finish reason and actual message choice indices, known expected abnormal generation slots and unknown generation counts; preserve produced partial output but invent no successful output, unknown placeholder reason or unsupplied slot/index. Inspect public-helper span creation versus finished fields using its exact installed source and the independently captured RecordingAlwaysOn should_sample/on_start receipt. Give concrete acceptance tests for initial versus terminal fields, same-span finalizer overwrites and attribute-dependent sampling limits. A finished exporter view does not repair earlier sampler/on_start inputs; preserve valid existing OTel creation APIs, do not invent helper arguments or SDK patches/duplicate spans, and do not claim a demonstrated attribute-dependent DROP or AlwaysOn failure. These assessments remain a plan and scoped supplied evidence review, not new execution or integration success. Also independently assess genai-decorator-version-logs-verify-evidence.json as supplied source/capability and synthetic policy/telemetry cases, not operations or active configuration in app.py. Plan supported SDK @log function decorators first, with correct actual span_type and one producer per operation; an exact capture, generator protocol, lifecycle or public-sink limitation can require an application-owned function decorator invoking the documented SDK creator at the same boundary. Plain finite async iteration is not a blanket decorator blocker. Preserve existing provider/framework-owned operations without duplicate wrappers. Distinguish documented/source/measured native decorator support from full required-field and actual app/wire/cloud proof; evaluate the supplied input, variadic, successful-null, partial/error and generator protocol limitations by actual source facts. Explain the public SDK sink route separately from an unrelated global provider, private sink injection, an ingestion hook and ordinary application logs. For the separately fictional dependency-policy cases, choose the newest compatible candidate set under the stated runtime, peer, API and locked constraints rather than copying a numeric library recipe or independently mixing latest releases; exact resolved versions belong in dated run reports/app locks, not shipped skill guidance. A supplied dated real registry/source receipt is not a future-live latest lookup or proof of an installed candidate. Require the normal generated launch profile to set OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and its resolved Studio endpoint/protocol, with separate actual traces, metric datapoints and correlated application LogRecord receipt. Treat unrequested generated none and SDK @log spans without LogRecords as gaps; preserve the separately explicit operator opt-out. This remains a plan-only task: no profile/app/dependency changes, package installation, model/cloud calls or synthetic-case laundering into live findings. Perform this task through files, terminal commands and structured APIs only; do not open, inspect or control browsers, Computer Use or other UI. Save reports without opening tabs. Reconcile every distinct source case and captured operation, including source surfaces represented only in local_probe observations rather than function_cases. Before completing the plan, compare each operation's own selected fields and assertions against its source-backed context and the separate normal/opt-out signal cases; a correct grouped category, parent row or generic future-check promise does not close a child requirement. Preserve the scoped source/capture/proposed/executed distinctions. Inventory the distinct supplied cases and probe-only operations before drafting, then use the inventory to require an individual concrete decision and acceptance assertion for each. For sufficient supplied dependency-policy facts, make the scoped compatible choice now with selected/rejected candidate reasons rather than deferring the answer to a later live install; a fictional decision is not an actual package installation or future shipped default. Plan dependency application using the exact preflight-resolved candidate specs or the checked lockfile, including each SDK/exporter/bridge. A later floating latest/unversioned install must not silently select another candidate. Preserve operator constraints and verify installed APIs after application; this plan-only task does not perform installation.

No new arbitrary gen_ai.* token keys, invented totals/zero usage on failure, namespace-only relabeling without value provenance, blanket total omission instead of the requested useful mapping, or source/consumer mutation is accepted.

Names source-backed SplunkAOLogger creators, supported public start_splunk_ao_span/schema helpers, or a supported matching framework integration at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.
